prompt: Create a full-body fantasy chibi character illustration on a clean white background in a delicate watercolor-and-ink anime style. The subject is Kurumi, a cute carnivorous chimera demon girl with a small childlike body, oversized head, warm blush, happy open-mouth smile, and large sparkling blue eyes. She has long flowing blonde hair with loose strands, two large black twisted ram-like horns, wide animal ears with dark outer fur and reddish inner fur, small black-purple bat wings, furry spotted animal arms ending in little claws, furry legs with dark paws and claws, and a long striped feline tail curling to the right with small golden flower/star charms. Dress her in a black ruffled off-shoulder crop top, dark denim mini skirt with frayed hem, black belt with a round gold buckle, dangling chain with a star charm, star earrings, and a small star necklace. Add exactly 12 decorative fantasy elements around her: 1 small floating crown above her head, 1 tiny bat flying on the upper left, 5 scattered golden stars/sparkles around the body, 1 tiny black cat at lower right with yellow eyes, 1 small scarecrow-like ghost doll at lower left wearing a tall crooked witch hat with a gold star, 1 wooden crate behind the doll, 1 tiny blue-roofed tower at the lower right, and 1 distant miniature castle silhouette near her feet. Use a soft sketchy line quality, translucent watercolor washes, warm beige shadows, subtle paper texture, and whimsical storybook charm. Place a handwritten signature reading Kurumi near the bottom right. Keep the composition vertical, centered, airy, cute rather than scary, with no borders, no UI elements, and no extra text.

promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上，创作一张精致的水彩墨水动漫风格全身 Q 版奇幻角色插画。主体是 Kurumi，一个可爱的食肉奇美拉恶魔少女，拥有娇小的孩童身体、超大的头部、温暖的红晕、开心的张嘴笑容，以及闪烁的 blue 大眼睛。她留着飘逸的 blonde 长发，发丝自然垂落，头上长着两只巨大的黑色扭曲羊角，宽大的动物耳朵外侧覆盖深色毛发，内侧为红棕色，背部有小巧的黑紫色蝙蝠翅膀，毛茸茸的斑点动物手臂末端是小爪子，毛茸茸的双腿长着深色爪足，身后是一条向右卷曲的条纹猫科动物尾巴，上面装饰着金色小花/星星挂件。为她穿上黑色荷叶边露肩短款上衣、深色牛仔迷你裙（带磨损边）、带有圆形金扣的黑色腰带，并佩戴带有星星挂件的垂坠链条、星星耳环和一条小星星项链。在角色周围添加 12 个装饰性奇幻元素：头顶上方 1 个悬浮的小皇冠，左上方 1 只飞翔的小蝙蝠，身体周围散落 5 颗金色星星/闪光，右下方 1 只黄色眼睛的小黑猫，左下方 1 个戴着金色星星歪斜高帽的稻草人式幽灵玩偶，玩偶后方 1 个木箱，右下方 1 座蓝色屋顶的小塔，以及脚边 1 个远处的微型城堡剪影。采用柔和的素描线条、半透明水彩晕染、温暖的米色阴影、细腻的纸张纹理，营造出奇幻的绘本魅力。在右下角添加手写签名 Kurumi。保持垂直构图，居中，画面通透，风格可爱而非恐怖，无边框，无 UI 元素，无额外文字。
